milestones.title: Degree / Formal Education
milestones.description: Enroll in and complete a recognised diploma or degree at a specialised academy or institute relevant to flight instructor

resources.title: Faculty of Education — Ain Shams University
Faculty of Education — Cairo University
Faculty of Education — Alexandria University

milestones.title: Core Skill Learning
milestones.description: Learn the fundamentals: build a solid foundation in Flight Instructor Certificate (CFI / FI), instructional techniques and adult learning principles, and lesson plan development for flight training — these are the essential building blocks for a flight instructor

resources.title: Instructional Design Foundations and Applications Specialization - Coursera (University of Illinois)
Principles of Learning and Teaching in the STEM Disciplines - edX (Curtin University)

milestones.title: Intermediate / Advanced Skills
milestones.description: Deepen your expertise by developing intermediate-to-advanced skills in assessment and debriefing skills, air law and training regulations, and safety management in training environments, applying them through exercises and case studies

resources.title: Aviation Safety Management System (SMS) Course
Aviation Law for Pilots
Aviation Human Factors and CRM (Crew Resource Management)

milestones.title: Hands-on Practice
milestones.description: Gain hands-on experience by completing teaching practice, lesson planning, or educational content development — focus on applying Flight Instructor Certificate (CFI / FI), and instructional techniques and adult learning principles in realistic scenarios

resources.title: FAA Aviation Instructor's Handbook (FAA-H-8083-9)
Aviation Safety Management Systems (SMS) Specialization - Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University (Coursera)
Flight Training Pro - CFI Ground School & Checkride Prep (YouTube Channel)

milestones.title: Portfolio Building
milestones.description: Create a teaching portfolio with lesson plans, student outcomes, classroom materials, and testimonials from students or supervisors

resources.title: Learning How to Learn: Powerful Mental Tools to Help You Master Tough Subjects (Coursera)
Adult Learning Principles and How to Apply Them (Udemy)
Aviation Safety Management System (SMS) for Beginners (Udemy)

milestones.title: CV / Profile Building
milestones.description: Prepare your professional profile: craft a targeted CV/resume highlighting your flight instructor skills, optimize your LinkedIn profile, and gather references or endorsements from mentors, instructors, or past collaborators

resources.title: Foundations of Teaching for Learning 1: Introduction to Student Learning
Aviation Safety Management System (SMS) Course
FAA Aviation Instructor's Handbook (AIH)
How To Teach: Aviation Instructional Techniques

milestones.title: Job Application
milestones.description: Apply for flight instructor positions at schools, colleges, universities, or online education platforms — prepare a teaching demo and bring your teaching portfolio to interviews
